chronology: Prior audited price sensitivities are known, including the40%/maturing-risk89.64 endpoint supplied by the parent. This is not a blind experiment. The following operating and risk judgments are recorded before any new return arithmetic or forecast revaluation in this reassessment; no desired target or probability is fitted.
selected_business_judgment: The recovery and richer mix are credible.40% mature DCAI margin is a legitimate bullish underwriting choice, but this review does not prefer it strongly enough over35% to make a higher-margin long the default. Current41.5% quarter and37.9% YTD result, actual multigeneration customer adoption and lower wafer costs support persistence. Supply shortages, mix-specific economics, rising lower-gross-margin custom silicon and concurrent customer adoption of competing CPUs limit permanence.

bull_case_to_evaluate.revenue_path: Keep existing already-strong accepted unit/ASP/custom growth through2030 and its existing long-run fade. Do not add Oracle or Google again as new revenue on top of this path.
bull_case_to_evaluate.risk_path: Show both existing flat11.555% and existing maturing risk; prefer flat as the valuation convention for an adopted recommendation until a reason is supplied for reducing systematic operating risk. Funding improvement alone does not mechanically lower asset beta.
bull_case_to_evaluate.extra_external_wafer_or_packaging_value: Zero incremental value in this reassessment. Existing overlay remains; no unannounced customer win or binding future volume is assumed.
bull_case_to_evaluate.near_term_capital: Unchanged. Equipment reuse and improved yield support output/cost recovery already modeled, while issuer still says capex and supplier commitments increase.

capital_upside_control.classification: Upside scenario only. Customer deposits and equity funding improve financing but do not themselves change sales per dollar of physical net investment. No independent upward central capital-productivity revision.

decision_standard: Choose a clear long or short only if the owned operating judgment and appropriate risk/holding-period comparison make it attractive. No requirement to survive every reasonable sensitivity, possess a unique provable terminal margin, produce statistically estimated probabilities, or guarantee a contest win.
